provenance.source_title: Your Life as a Fake Guru at Every Level

examples.psychological_goal: 用章节卡+年龄+住所三连定格猎物起点
examples.expression_mechanism: 层级章节卡+处境三连（19岁/母亲的公寓）
examples.example_text: Level one. The believer. You are 19 years old. You live in your mother's apartment.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「第X级+绰号」开场卡与一句年龄+住所定格，绰号即人物本质
examples.negative_instruction: 绰号（believer）必须同时是反讽预告，不可中性

examples.psychological_goal: 用三连排比复现收割话术
examples.expression_mechanism: 话术三连（学校是骗局/工作是奴役/我曾像你一样）
examples.example_text: He tells you that a job is slavery. He tells you that he was broke just like you.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用 He tells you 三连让观众先尝到话术的甜味，为后文拆解蓄力
examples.negative_instruction: 三连必须递进（反体制/反工作/套近乎），不可同义重复

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个身体细节把欲望正当化
examples.expression_mechanism: 肿胀的双脚+救她的誓言
examples.example_text: You watch her feet swell. You promise yourself you will save her.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一个具体身体细节给人物的决定装上道德引擎
examples.negative_instruction: 细节必须是长期磨损（肿胀），不可用突发重病

examples.psychological_goal: 用主宾倒置提前引爆全片题眼
examples.expression_mechanism: 主宾倒置（计划不是产品，你才是产品）
examples.example_text: the plan was never the product. You were the product.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「X从来不是产品，你才是」的倒置句点破商业模式
examples.negative_instruction: 题眼必须提前落下但不展开（Not yet.），不可当时说透

examples.psychological_goal: 用自我指认完成最悲哀的机制总结
examples.expression_mechanism: 自我指认（完美客户=更年轻的自己）
examples.example_text: the perfect customer is a younger version of yourself.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习让角色亲手写下「我在收割过去的自己」的判词
examples.negative_instruction: 判词必须以customer等商业词汇包装痛感，不可直接抒情

examples.psychological_goal: 一句话戳破知识产品的真实门槛
examples.expression_mechanism: 门槛降级（比买家多懂一点）
examples.example_text: You only need to know slightly more than your buyer.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「只需要比X多一点」句型揭示行业的低门槛真相
examples.negative_instruction: slightly 是关键，不可写成「足够多」

examples.psychological_goal: 用资源定性揭穿复购的本质
examples.expression_mechanism: 资源定性（希望是可再生资源）
examples.example_text: You learn that selling to existing fans is easier than finding new ones. You learn that hope is a renewable resource.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「X是一种可再生资源」把情感商品化
examples.negative_instruction: 被定性的必须是情感（希望），不可是实物

examples.psychological_goal: 用双句式揭穿模型的自动脱罪机制
examples.expression_mechanism: 功劳/归罪分离（成功者本来就会/失败者怪 mindset）
examples.example_text: The ones who succeed would have succeeded anyway. The ones who fail blame themselves, not you.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「赢家归我/输家归你」的双句拆穿自洁模型
examples.negative_instruction: 两句必须共用同一主语群（the ones），不可分开举例

examples.psychological_goal: 用术语错置给交易重新命名
examples.expression_mechanism: 术语错置（发票叫作蜕变）
examples.example_text: You have become a man who sells comfort to the desperate and calls the invoice a transformation.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「卖A给B，并把C叫作D」句型给交易行为定性
examples.negative_instruction: C/D必须是行业黑话与实物（invoice/transformation）的对撞

examples.psychological_goal: 用比喻拆穿营销概念
examples.expression_mechanism: 概念卸妆（稀缺穿了西装）
examples.example_text: Exclusivity is just scarcity wearing a suit.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「X只是Y穿了一件西装」给高级词汇卸妆
examples.negative_instruction: Y必须是朴素真相（scarcity），不可两个都是大词

examples.psychological_goal: 用剧本原句+命名句展示高压销售术
examples.expression_mechanism: 剧本原句+包装命名（赢家独自决定/压力包装成动力）
examples.example_text: If they need to ask their wife, tell them winners decide alone. You package pressure as motivation.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先给一句真实剧本再给包装命名，让读者既见刀又见鞘
examples.negative_instruction: 剧本必须是可以被反驳的操纵（问妻子），不可写成合理建议

examples.psychological_goal: 用比例定律给空虚定价
examples.expression_mechanism: 等比定律（空洞与钱等比增长）
examples.example_text: The emptiness grows in exact proportion to the money, as if the two things were always secretly the same.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「X与Y等比增长」把两种度量焊成一体
examples.negative_instruction: 结尾的 same 判定是关键，不可停在比例

examples.psychological_goal: 一句话点破合法与正当的距离
examples.expression_mechanism: 合法化炼金术（paperwork 让弱产品合法）
examples.example_text: the right paperwork can make a weak product legal.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「对的X能让Y合法」揭示合规与道德的分层
examples.negative_instruction: 必须只说 legal 不说 right，让读者自己感到缝隙

examples.psychological_goal: 让最不该问的人问出那句问题
examples.expression_mechanism: 至亲的直问（你骗人是不是真的）
examples.example_text: He asks if it is true that you scam people.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习让最无辜的角色用最大白话问出全片最怕的问题
examples.negative_instruction: 问题必须是孩子的原句，不可成人化修饰

examples.psychological_goal: 用比较级给一句谎言估价
examples.expression_mechanism: 代价比较（比任何诉讼都贵）
examples.example_text: That lie cost you more than any lawsuit ever did.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「比法律代价更贵」给道德代价标价
examples.negative_instruction: 被比较的必须都是可计量的东西（lie vs lawsuit）

examples.psychological_goal: 用递归句展示金字塔的完整一层
examples.expression_mechanism: 递归销售（把蓝图卖给卖课的人）
examples.example_text: You sell the blueprint to the men who sell courses to broke young men.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「你卖X给卖Y给Z的人」的递归句展示层级上移
examples.negative_instruction: 递归的每一环必须是前文出现过的角色

examples.psychological_goal: 用对偶句给塔尖秘密定性
examples.expression_mechanism: 对偶经文（产品不重要，信念才是产品）
examples.example_text: The product does not matter. The belief is the product.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「X不重要，Y才是X」的对偶句给行业终极秘密定型
examples.negative_instruction: Y必须由X衍生（product→belief），不可换词

examples.psychological_goal: 用唯一性判词拆掉整个帝国
examples.expression_mechanism: 唯一性判词（唯一真正的信徒是过去的你）
examples.example_text: the only true believer was the broke kid on the floor.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「唯一真正的X是Y」把百万粉丝的帝国归零
examples.negative_instruction: Y必须是开场的那个人物原型，不可新造

examples.psychological_goal: 用唯一兑现的诺言完成总账
examples.expression_mechanism: 唯一性兑付（唯一真正兑现的诺言）
examples.example_text: She died in the house you bought her, which is the one promise from your whole life you actually kept.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「一生诺言中唯一兑现的那一个」给人物留最后一寸人性
examples.negative_instruction: 被兑现的诺言必须是开场许下的（买房），不可新造

examples.psychological_goal: 用动作三连完成循环并预告命运
examples.expression_mechanism: 动作三连+命运预告（点击/恶心/希望/不知道将成为什么）
examples.example_text: He clicks buy. He feels sick. He feels hope. He has no idea what he is about to become.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用三个微动作+一句无知预告，把开头的你又复制给新人物
examples.negative_instruction: 动作必须与开场主角的完全同构（click/sick/hope），不可改写
